description: Sticky, zoned toolbar for tp-* components.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code: Document Document area

methods.name: addButtonToSection(button: HTMLElement, section: string): void
methods.description: Moves the supplied element into section start, center or end. Throws if the toolbar is not initialized or the section name is invalid.

cssproperties.name: --tp-toolbar-gap
cssproperties.description: Space between the toolbar sections along its main axis.

cssproperties.name: --tp-toolbar-padding
cssproperties.description: Inner spacing around the toolbar content.

cssproperties.name: --tp-toolbar-section-gap
cssproperties.description: Space between controls within a section and around section separators.

cssproperties.name: --tp-toolbar-size
cssproperties.description: Minimum toolbar thickness: height for a horizontal toolbar, width for a vertical toolbar.

cssproperties.name: --tp-toolbar-z-index
cssproperties.description: Stacking level of the sticky toolbar relative to overlapping content.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-toolbar>` element implements the <tp-icon name="toolbar" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Toolbar functionality: sticky, zoned toolbar for tp-* components.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Reading | This component organizes or presents content. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Component itself | No dedicated keyboard action. |
| Embedded controls, when present | Use their normal keyboard interactions. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
